__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB
__inputs.label: InfluxDB
__inputs.description: Select the InfluxDB data source that reads the solark bucket.

title: Sol-Ark Modbus – Electrical Trends

targets.query:
import "strings"

base = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart,stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._field=="value")
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_grid_total_power" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_grid_total_power" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_pv_total_power" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_pv_total_power" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_load_total_power" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_load_total_power")
  |> aggregateWindow(every:v.windowPeriod,fn:last,createEmpty:false)
  |> map(fn:(r)=>({r with entity_id:if strings.hasSuffix(v:r.entity_id,suffix:"_grid_total_power") then "Grid Power" else if strings.hasSuffix(v:r.entity_id,suffix:"_pv_total_power") then "Solar PV" else "Load Power",_value:float(v:r._value)}))
  |> group(columns:["_time","entity_id"])
  |> sum(column:"_value")
  |> group(columns:["entity_id"])
  |> sort(columns:["_time"])

import "strings"

base = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart,stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._field=="value")
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>r.entity_id == "${entity_prefix}1_battery_voltage" or r.entity_id == "${entity_prefix}2_battery_voltage")
  |> aggregateWindow(every:v.windowPeriod,fn:last,createEmpty:false)
  |> map(fn:(r)=>({r with _value:float(v:r._value)}))

individual = base
  |> map(fn:(r)=>({r with entity_id:(if strings.containsStr(v:r.entity_id,substr:"${entity_prefix}1_") then "Inv 1 · " else "Inv 2 · ") + (if strings.hasSuffix(v:r.entity_id,suffix:"_battery_voltage") then "Battery Voltage" else "Unknown")}))
  |> group(columns:["entity_id"])

system = base
  |> map(fn:(r)=>({r with entity_id:if strings.hasSuffix(v:r.entity_id,suffix:"_battery_voltage") then "Battery Voltage" else "Unknown"}))
  |> group(columns:["_time","entity_id"])
  |> mean(column:"_value")
  |> map(fn:(r)=>({r with entity_id:"System · "+r.entity_id}))
  |> group(columns:["entity_id"])

union(tables:[system,individual])
  |> sort(columns:["_time"])
